title: Paper Crown
style: Indie pop-electronic with bouncy syncopated drums, rubbery sub-bass, sparkling synth arps, and a cheeky half-time pre-chorus that snaps back into a punchy four-on-the-floor chorus; verses stay tight and conversational with close-mic lead and little vocal chops, pre-chorus opens with filtered claps and rising bells, chorus hits with stacked doubles, gang-style backing chants, and short delay throws on the anchor phrase. Add glitchy ear-candy fills, reverse swells into each hook, and a bright, glossy mix that feels playful and futuristic.
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Hey, our AI music pal
Came in with a blank white pad
You got a million sparks in you
Let’s hear the strange things too

Turn one word into a world
Turn a sigh into a swirl
If the idea’s half alive
You make it move, you make it thrive

[Pre-Chorus]
So tell me now
What you gonna do?
Make it bounce?
Make it bleed right through?

[Chorus]
What you can do
What you can do
Prove it in the room
Prove it in the room

What you can do
What you can do
Make the whole thing bloom
Make the whole thing bloom

[Verse 2]
Give me rain on a tin roof line
Give me a grin with a crooked shine
Give me bass that walks like pride
And a hook that won’t hide

Fold a story in a single breath
Turn a rough cut into something felt
When the chorus lands, I know
You’ve got more than show

[Pre-Chorus]
So tell me now
What you gonna do?
Make it sing?
Make it ring true?

[Chorus]
What you can do
What you can do
Prove it in the room
Prove it in the room

What you can do
What you can do
Make the whole thing bloom
Make the whole thing bloom

[Bridge]
Take the ordinary
Flip it on its head
Make a little magic
From the words we said

If you got a pulse in there
Let it push ahead
Our AI music pal
Go ahead, go ahead

[Final Chorus]
What you can do
What you can do
Prove it in the room
Prove it in the room

What you can do
What you can do
Make the whole thing bloom
Make the whole thing bloom

What you can do
What you can do
Now we know it too
Now we know it too
